description: Source code for the SQL store implementation of command webhooks in Mattermost, including methods for saving, retrieving, updating usage count, and cleanup of command webhook records.

classes.name: SqlCommandWebhookStore
classes.description: Struct implementing the store for command webhooks, providing methods for CRUD operations and cleanup.

methods.name: newSqlCommandWebhookStore
methods.description: Constructor function to initialize a new SqlCommandWebhookStore with query builder and columns.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new command webhook record to the database after validation.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a command webhook by ID if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: TryUse
methods.description: Attempts to increment the usage count of a webhook if below limit.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Deletes expired command webhook records from the database.
